backend/main.mo: Actor implementing user profiles, Stripe checkout/session handling, capture storage, and access-controlled endpoints using mixins and maps.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature requests to affected frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing various frontend utilities, pages, hooks, and components.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme variables, dark mode tokens, and global base styles.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry file mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main router setup configuring public and authenticated routes with layout, auth checks, and page components.
frontend/src/components/ai/AICaptionGene: UI component for generating client-side social media captions with inputs, preview suggestions, and copy-to-clipboard.
frontend/src/components/billing/StripeBu: Reusable wrapper that loads the Stripe Buy Button script and renders the custom checkout element with loading/error states.
frontend/src/components/billing/StripeCh: UI panel to view, edit, validate, and save Stripe checkout URLs with success/error feedback.
frontend/src/components/billing/UpgradeT: Displays Pro status or upgrade options, using Stripe Buy Button or fallback redirect to checkout.
frontend/src/components/captures/DeleteC: Confirmation dialog for deleting a capture with disabled buttons during deletion.
frontend/src/components/captures/SaveCap: Dialog to review caption and save a photo or video capture with upload progress and success/error states.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: App shell with header, footer, and routed content, ensuring Stripe script loads globally.
frontend/src/components/layout/Footer.ts: Footer with links, attribution, and dynamic year plus referral link generation.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: Top navigation bar showing links based on login state and handling logout logic.
frontend/src/components/security/Securit: Form to add, edit, validate, and submit multiple security questions with dynamic fields.
frontend/src/config/stripeCheckoutConfig: Manages Stripe checkout config in localStorage and validates the checkout URL.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor based on II identity and refreshes dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useCaptures.ts: Provides hooks to fetch, save, and delete user captures via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Handles Internet Identity auth, stored identities, and login state via a context provider.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Wraps backend user profile operations with React Query for fetching and saving profiles.
Implements queries and mutations for checking, setting, verifying, and resetting security questions.
frontend/src/hooks/useStripeBuyButtonScr: Loads the Stripe Buy Button script once and exposes its loading state.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideoRecorder.ts: Provides video recording controls using MediaRecorder, managing state, blobs, and errors.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and custom CSS variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/AccountRecoveryPage.t: Implements a multi-step account recovery flow for verifying and resetting security questions with form validation and API mutations.
frontend/src/pages/CameraPage.tsx: Provides camera access for capturing photos and videos, managing recordings, and saving media with captions, including redirects if security setup is incomplete.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Displays user profile, subscription info, and tools, with security-question checks and refresh handling for the main user dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/FaqHelpCenterPage.tsx: Static FAQ page explaining subscriptions, camera usage, account help, and general support info.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Marketing landing page with hero content, feature highlights, and navigation to login or dashboard based on authentication.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page handling Internet Identity authentication and redirecting users based on security question setup status.
frontend/src/pages/MyCapturesPage.tsx: Displays user captures with filtering, sorting, and deletion, including Pro feature gating.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentCancelPage.tsx: Shows a payment cancellation message with options to return to the dashboard or retry.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccessPage.ts: Confirms successful payment and provides navigation back to the dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPolicyPage.tsx: Renders the privacy policy detailing data collection, usage, sharing, and requirements.
frontend/src/pages/SecurityQuestionsSetu: Guides users through setting security questions and redirects if already configured.
frontend/src/pages/TermsPage.tsx: Renders a styled Terms of Service page using Card components and sectioned legal text.
frontend/src/types/stripe-buy-button.d.t: Adds JSX typing for the custom stripe-buy-button web component.
frontend/src/utils/captionGenerator.ts: Generates caption suggestions using tone-based templates, platform emojis, and CTAs.
frontend/src/utils/fileToBytes.ts: Converts a File or Blob into a Uint8Array via FileReader.
frontend/src/utils/subscriptionTier.ts: Maps subscription tiers to labels and provides helpers for checking Free/Pro tiers.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, storing, and persisting URL parameters across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: TailwindCSS config extending theme colors, typography, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks project metadata, existing features, and pending requests for CloudCam AI.
